name: Record of '99
source:
Alice de Misery got a job.

Dense audio-visual layering inspired both by sound novels, and homaging to the PC-98  Era of visual novels.

Absurdist, and pained. Sincere, while laughing through something. Most recommended for those who enjoy a mixture of both at the same time.

[From [url=https://newmillennium.itch.io/record-of-99]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
爱丽丝·德·米泽里找到了一份工作。

浓密交织的视听层次既汲取了有声小说的灵感，也向PC-98时代的视觉小说致以敬意。

荒诞不经，却又满怀痛楚；真挚坦诚，却又带着苦中作乐的笑意。格外推荐给喜爱将这两种滋味融为一炉的玩家。

[摘自[url=https://newmillennium.itch.io/record-of-99]itch.io[/url]]
